blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Police arrested 41 wanted persons, including three listed as most wanted, during a simultaneous regionwide “Warrant Day” operation in Eastern Visayas on Saturday, Sept. 26. The Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) said its units conducted 41 separate operations that led to the arrest of three most wanted persons (MWPs) and 38 other wanted persons (OWPs). Among those arrested was Biliran province’s most wanted person, who is facing charges of rape and statutory rape, with no bail recommended. The suspect was arrested in a joint operation by the Biliran Provincial Intelligence Unit and Pasay City Police Sub-Station 3. READ: […]...
